intro: Benin has about 14 million people from over 40 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: The Fon, Adja, Yoruba and Bariba are among the largest groups. French is official. Christianity, Islam and Vodun are all widely practised, often side by side.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Cotonou is the biggest city; Porto-Novo is the official capital.
